name: Cubing with the Viking 2020

venue.name: Ellison Campus Center, Salem State University
venue.details: The competition is in Veterans Hall, which is on the second floor of the Ellison Campus Center.

information: The Ellison Campus Center is #10 on the map which can be found [here](https://www.salemstate.edu/sites/default/files/pdfs/SSU_CAMPUS%20MAP_WEB_06_18.pdf).  Money raised from this competition will be going toward the SSU Community Service Initiative for use in their Alternative Spring Break trip which works with organizations like Habitat for Humanity and SBP in disaster relief efforts.
